_comment: The one folder listing (owner, 2026-10-23): the files a folder or a glob names, the same in both runtimes and for every caller (core's per-file batch, the fs toolkit's resolve_inputs). Files only (a folder is never listed), in natural order of each file's path below the folder (clip1, clip2, clip10; ties by the name as written), not into subfolders unless recursive, a glob matched against the file name. A folder that does not exist lists nothing. `files` are created under the test's base folder; `expected` are paths relative to `folder`. Python `knaif.batch_chain.list_files`, Rust `knaif_core::batch_chain::list_files`.

cases.name: a folder, natural order, files only
recursive orders by the path below the folder
a folder that does not exist
zero-padding ties fall back to the name
a recursive glob matches names at any depth
